O bando de Ronin procura agora a ajuda de Kai um mestiço que eles haviam rejeitado enquanto enfrentam um mundo de bestas míticas e bruxarias assombrosas.

programme.title: Aeroporto
programme.desc: Mel Bakersfeld é o responsável pelas operações do Aeroporto Internacional de Chicago, que tenta manter em funcionamento durante uma devastadora tempestade de neve, ao mesmo tempo que um bombista suicida ameaça rebentar um Boeing 707 em pleno voo.

programme.title: Academia De Polícia 3 De Volta Aos Treinos
programme.desc: Os alunos do comandante Lassard regressam à Academia de Polícia para treinar novos recrutas e prevenir o encerramento da escola.

programme.title: Kickboxer 2 O Regresso
programme.desc: Um ano depois de Kurt Sloane derrotar Tong Po no torneio de kickboxing, o seu irmão David Sloane, que se esforça para manter à tona uma academia de kickboxing em Los Angeles, é forçado a entrar no ringue para uma luta de desforra contra Po.

programme.title: Arsenal
programme.desc: Os irmãos JP e Mikey tiveram uma infância complicada. Atualmente, o primeiro é dono de uma empresa de construção mas o segundo é um pequeno mafioso, que é raptado pelo criminoso Eddie King. JP vai arriscar tudo para resgatar o irmão, que sempre fez tudo por ele.

programme.title: Diana
programme.desc: Sofia é uma acompanhante de luxo que trabalha em casa e apresenta-se aos clientes como Manuela. Jano é seu cliente e apresenta-se como Hugo. Quem são Sofia e Jano Nenhum deles é quem parece ser

programme.title: Rebelde
programme.desc: Kamal é um jovem belga de origem marroquina que decide partir para Raqqa para ajudar as vítimas da guerra na Síria, onde é forçado a juntar-se a uma milícia. Em casa, o seu irmão mais novo torna-se uma presa fácil para recrutadores radicais, que lhe prometem que irá reunir-se com o irmão.

programme.title: Mozart - Così fan tutte
programme.desc: Maestro Zubin Mehta leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s comic opera Così fan tutte (1790). Following the successful operas Le nozze di Figaro (1786) and Don Giovanni (1787), Così fan tutte was the third and last collaboration between Mozart and the Venetian librettist and poet Lorenzo Da Ponte.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o.
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Symphony No. 3, Op. 78
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Camille Saint-Saëns’ (1835-1921) Symphony No. 3, Op. 78. Geert Bierling stars as soloist on the organ of De Doelen. It was recorded on October 20th, 2018 in Rotterdam, The Netherlands. Saint-Saëns Symphony No. 3 was completed in 1886. It is known as the Organ Symphony since the instrument is used in the second and fourth movement of the work.

programme.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 3, K. 216
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 2, 14 And 16
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: B. Strozzi - Sino alla morte
programme.desc: Argentinian conductor and harpsichordist Leonardo García Alarcón leads his ensemble Cappella Mediterranea in a program of Italian Baroque music. The ensemble performs some of the finest Baroque pieces composed by Francesco Cavalli, a prominent composer in 17th-century Venice, and two of his famous students, Barbara Strozzi and Antonia Bembo. Argentinian soprano Mariana Flores presents the vocal works.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Ravel - La Valse
programme.desc: The exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a performance of Maurice Ravel’s La Valse, in an arrangement for two pianos. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's 'Resurrection' Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Elgar - Concerto for Cello, Op. 85
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra and the young American cellist Alisa Weilerstein, who has attracted widespread attention for her passionate yet precise musicianship, perform a breathtaking rendition of Edward Elgar’s Cello Concerto, Op. 85.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 1, Op. 11
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 1 in F-sharp minor, Op. 11. Schumann completed the work in 1835 and dedicated it to his beloved, Clara Wieck.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Bacchetti performs Bach, Haydn and Mozart
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti appears both as conductor and soloist in this concert recorded at Teatro Chiabrera in the Italian city of Savona. He is accompanied by I Musici di Parma. On the program are J. S. Bach’s Prelude and Fugue in E major, BWV 878 (The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book II, No. 9), Joseph Haydn's Piano Concerto No. 11 in D major (Hob.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Karita Mattila (soprano), Violeta Urmana (alto), Thomas Moser (tenor), Eike Wilm Schulte (bass), Swedish Radio Choir, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir, Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, conductor: Claudio Abbado. Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991.

programme.title: Martha Argerich – A Birthday Celebration III
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Lensky’s aria from Eugene Onegin
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, the celebrated pianist performs the signature piece with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who made his debut here with the orchestra.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43
programme.desc: In this 2018 concert, the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra is lead by Canadian conductor and pianist Yannick Nézet-Séguin in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 4 in C minor, Op. 43. Born in 1975 in Montréal, Québec, the charismatic young musician was awarded the role of the 11th Principal Conductor of the Rotterdam Philharmonic Orchestra in 2006.

programme.title: Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: Composed between 1901 and 1902, Mahler's Fifth Symphony marked a significant shift in his compositional style, moving away from vocal elements toward a purely symphonic structure. It's a work of immense scope and emotional depth, known for its rich orchestral textures and intricate counterpoint.

programme.title: Schumann - Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Symphonic Etudes, Op. 13. Composed between 1834-37, the work began as a theme and a set of sixteen variations.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student.

programme.title: Beethoven Violin Concerto And Bizet Symphony in C
programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. Having played in various local youth and symphony orchestras as a violinist, her first experience conducting an ensemble followed in 2012. In September 2020, she won the Orchestra Prize at La Maestra Competition – the first orchestra direction contest for women – held in Paris.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Gluck - Iphigénie en Tauride
programme.desc: Iphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Written for the French stage, the work’s premiere in 1779 at the Parisian Royal Academy of Music was a great success. Iphigénie en Tauride is one of the composer’s ‘reform operas’, meaning that the music was to follow the drama and its expression.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 5, KV 283
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5, KV. 283. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Duparc, Borodin et al.
programme.desc: Mezzo-soprano Esther Valentin (Germany, 1993) and pianist Anastasia Grishutina (Russia, 1988) perform Henri Duparc’s L’invitation au voyage; Aleksandr Borodin’s ‘Dlya beregov otchizni dal’noy’ (For the shores of thy far native land); ‘Fleur jetée’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Quatre melodies, Op. 39; Franz Schubert’s Die Liebe hat gelogen, Op. 23 No. 1 (D.

programme.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon. In ‘The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres’ they perform music by Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel to a backdrop of high-definition images from the Hubble telescope, NASA and Canadian astronomers.

programme.title: Franck - Sonata for violin and piano
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and violinist Maxim Vengerov perform César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Arvo Pärt - Kanon Pokajanen
programme.desc: Arvo Pärt based his ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ (from ‘Canon of Repentance to Our Lord Jesus Christ’, 1995-97) on the canon of repentance as handed down in the earliest Slavic-Christian manuscripts, dating back to the sixth century after Christ. The canon symbolizes the change, the transformation from day to night, the Old and New Testament, prophecy and the fulfillment, the here and now and the hereafter.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 6 and 15
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Glass - Double Concerto for Two Pianos
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer of 'music with repetitive structures' Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for two pianos with the Orchester de Paris conducted by Jaap van Zweden, current music director of the New York Philharmonic.

programme.title: Works by Haydn, Mozart and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: Italian cellist and conductor Enrico Bronzi leads the Orchestra da Camera di Perugia in this intimate concert at the magnificent Basilica di San Pietro in the Italian city of Perugia, recorded on September 27, 2021. Opening the program is a cello performance by Bronzi with the Orchestra da Camera di Peruglia: the Andante cantabile from Joseph Haydn’s Symphony No. 13 in D major, Hob. I:13.

programme.title: Mahler - The Youth Wunderhorn
programme.desc: The Youth Wunderhorn songs are a set of 12 orchestral lieder by Mahler, based on folk poems from the collection by Arnim and Brentano, blending romanticism with folk elements and exploring human experience with authenticity and profound emotional depth. The songs draw from German folk traditions, incorporating themes of nature, love, and soldier life, often with a dramatic or poignant quality.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: 'It would be hard to find anything greater, more significant or more moving anywhere in musical life today: total harmony of mind and heart, poetry and outcry, fear and consolation, knowing and feeling,' declared the Berne paper Der Bund after this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003 by the newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra.

programme.title: Liszt’s Concerto No. 1 And Mahler’s Symphony No. 5
programme.desc: American ‘Conductor Laureate’ Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a program of romantic masterworks. The concert opens with Franz Liszt’s Piano Concerto No. 1, featuring the brilliant Czech pianist Lukáš Vondrácek as soloist. The evening concludes with the emotional journey of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 5. This performance was recorded at the Barbican Hall in London, UK, on May 15, 2022.

programme.title: Beethoven - Quintet for piano and winds, Op. 16
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Ludwig van Beethoven’s Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, Op. 16. The piece, completed in 1796, is assumed to have been modelled on Mozart’s Quintet for piano and winds, K. 452.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece’s premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works –Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 5, Op. 47
programme.desc: Maestro Jaap van Zweden conducts the Orchestre de Paris in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 5 in D minor, Op. 47. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, on March 9, 2016.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, ‘Eroica’. Composed in 1803 and 1804, this symphony is regarded as a major turning point in Beethoven’s oeuvre as well as Western music history. Symphony No. 3 is longer in duration than any previous symphony.

programme.title: Donizetti - Don Pasquale
programme.desc: Frédéric Chaslin leads the Orchestre Symphonique Région Centre-Val de Loire/Tours and the Choir of Opéra de Tours in a performance of Gaetano Donizetti’s comic opera Don Pasquale (1842). Featuring a cast of the most famous singers of the day, Don Pasquale premiered at the Parisian Salle Ventadour in 1843. It was an immediate success, being performed in the great opera houses of Europe within a year after its premiere.

programme.title: Martha Argerich – A Birthday Celebration - I
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’

programme.desc: Neste programa documental acompanhamos um dia completo na vida de uma pessoa, que pode ser uma celebridade, um artista, um artesão ou alguém anónimo, como um taxista. Da manhã à noite, a câmara observa as rotinas, os gestos e os momentos mais banais ou marcantes do quotidiano, revelando vidas que podem ser surpreendentemente diferentes — ou profundamente semelhantes — à do espectador.

programme.title: Nave Voadora: Santa Maria Da Feira
programme.desc: Rita Ferro Rodrigues segue a Bibliobus e o projeto 'Leituras em Linha' em Santa Maria da Feira, levando livros a crianças, trabalhadores de fábricas e idosos. Tomás, de 89 anos, diverte-se lendo anedotas, enquanto as crianças brincam equilibrando livros na cabeça. Um episódio que revela como a leitura desperta alegria, amizade e pequenos momentos de magia no dia a dia.

Aqui a feira não é só comércio — é mar e monte, fé e sustento, é história a acontecer à sombra dos toldos e ao som do pregão. Aqui, tudo tem cor: os sapatos as vozes, as saias das mulheres que vendem com orgulho e graça. As vozes são firmes, as saias são sete.

programme.title: De Gente And De Vinha: Entre O Caos E A Terra - Quinta Da Boavista
programme.desc: De Gente And De Vinha, um retrato intimista do mundo vitivinícola, apresentado com o requinte e poesia do chef André Magalhães, percorre conversas e deambulações por entre quintas familiares, castas em extinção, tabernas e adegas centenárias.'De Gente And De Vinha acompanha uma família que encontrou neste lugar o seu pouso definitivo, entre vinhas, memórias e gestos que se repetem no tempo.Há lugares onde o tempo não passa - escuta-se.

programme.title: Feira Semanal: Nazaré
programme.desc: Na Nazaré, a feira mistura-se com o vento, sal e com o som do mar. É uma extensão da vida piscatória, mas também uma celebração da terra e da fé. Aqui a feira não é só comércio — é mar e monte, fé e sustento, é história a acontecer à sombra dos toldos e ao som do pregão. Aqui, tudo tem cor: os sapatos as vozes, as saias das mulheres que vendem com orgulho e graça. As vozes são firmes, as saias são sete.

programme.desc: Num formato intimista de 11 minutos, o programa acompanha Margarida Pinto Correia em conversas próximas com músicos, centradas nas canções. 'Cavalos de Corrida' era uma sátira à exploração dos trabalhadores, mas o rock trocou as voltas ao que as pessoas ouviam. António Manuel Ribeiro conta os mais de 45 anos deste êxito icónico dos UHF.

programme.title: Nave Voadora: Santa Maria Da Feira
programme.desc: Rita Ferro Rodrigues segue a Bibliobus e o projeto 'Leituras em Linha' em Santa Maria da Feira, levando livros a crianças, trabalhadores de fábricas e idosos. Tomás, de 89 anos, diverte-se lendo anedotas, enquanto as crianças brincam equilibrando livros na cabeça. Um episódio que revela como a leitura desperta alegria, amizade e pequenos momentos de magia no dia a dia.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 114
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 76
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 61
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 22
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 24
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 81
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Apasionado
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr. - Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr.

programme.title: Michel Legrand Orchestra at Spa, 1982
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra.

programme.title: Live at the Office: BIGYUKI And Now vs Now
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Playa del Carmen
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: Episode 1: Thelonious Monk - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Antonio Faraò 4tet
programme.desc: Antonio Faraò features prominently in the rich group of talented Italian pianists. He is the winner of the 1998 prestigious Concours Martial Solal, awarded by Herbie Hancock, and he has made his mark as a player of elegance and lyricism. This has allowed him to collaborate with the best European and American musicians. In his album ‘Evan’, recorded in the USA, he leads an all-star band, notably starring Joe Lovano on tenor.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks And Company - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1988, vocalist Bobby McFerrin appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Carrie Smith
programme.desc: Veteran American blues and jazz singer Carrie Smith (1925-2012) was often compared to the legendary Bessie Smith, an artist she greatly admired. She was best known in Europe for her powerful, resonant voice, impeccable timing, and the emotional depth she brought to her songs.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio
programme.desc: The Cuban pianist, composer and bandleader Gonzalo Rubalcaba is a star name on today's international jazz scene. Technically dazzling and brilliantly creative, Rubalcaba generates infectious excitement with his music. He says he uses jazz as a reference, but takes in the Cuban and African background which was itself an important influence on jazz musicians in the US.

programme.title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow.

programme.title: Kenny G - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, smooth jazz saxophonist and crowd-favorite Kenny G serenaded those attending the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Parisien meets Kühn And Portal
programme.desc: Since his first appearance at Jazz in Ramatuelle in 2010, saxophonist Émile Parisien has made his mark among the most talented musicians of his generation. On the soprano saxophone, his favorite instrument, he invented a unique lyrical style.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Shayna Steele
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Clair de Lune
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: Marius Neset - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. In 2019, one of them is Copenhagen-based Norwegian saxophonist Marius Neset, who is known internationally for his collaborations with People Are Machines, Kaktusch, JazzKamikaze, and Django Bates' projects StoRMChaser and Human Chain.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan 'The Divine One' in 1958
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the Divine One in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as “Lover Man”, “Misty”, and “I Got Rhythm” and popular showtunes such as “Over The Rainbow” and “Maria”. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins, and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Baptiste Trontignon
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: Travellin’ Blues: Big Daddy Wilson
programme.desc: ‘Jazz en Baie’, a whining guitar sound, and the baritone voice of Big Daddy Wilson are the perfect recipe for an emotional and melancholy blues concert. As a young man, Big Daddy Wilson never saw a real blues concert before he walked into a Bremen club as a young soldier. This revelation drove the expatriate to throw himself head over heals into music.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Blues
programme.desc: In 1971, the camera crew of the Western series Gunsmoke travelled from Hollywood to the Pacific Northwest to capture blues greats Muddy Waters, Big Joe Turner, Big Mama Thornton and George “Harmonica” Smith during their tour. This documentary shows some of their best performances at the University of Oregon followed by footage and interviews on the road.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, Cuban pianist and vocalist Roberto Fonseca performed at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: John Lewis: Piano Solo
programme.desc: Pianist John Lewis, co-founder and long-time leader of the legendary Modern Jazz Quartet, wrote jazz history with that band. His ability to blend classical forms with jazz improvisations singled him out as a unique artist, who was capable of transcending every musical barrier. When the Modern Jazz Quartet retired, John Lewis continued to work with other musicians and as a solo pianist.

programme.title: Smooth Series at NSJ: George Benson And Kenny G
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Bad Ass And Blind
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: Hackensack
programme.desc: Explore the music of one of the most influential and innovative saxophonists in jazz history: John Coltrane! Immerse yourself in this collection of remarkable performances from the early 1960s that showcase Coltrane's unparalleled artistry and unique sound during a transformative period in the artist’s career.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Art Blakey And The Jazz Messengers - Olympia, Paris
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right.

programme.title: Buck Clayton - Radio Télévision Suisse 'Variétés'
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland.

programme.title: Chick Corea And Gary Burton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: VEIN Plays Ravel
programme.desc: A sound support with provocative combinations, a modern music laboratory, a vehicle of inspiration whose importance has been proven by many high-profile collaborations. Music lovers who appreciate jazz for its ability to provoke and continuously question the status quo certainly do not expect that such a standard set in its configuration finds itself completely detached from tradition.

programme.title: In pursuit of the 27th man
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: SummerJazz Leiden
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part I
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist.

programme.title: Solo Piano Summit
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a 'Solo Piano Summit,' audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The 'Solo Piano Summit' brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson.

programme.title: Duke Ellington Orchestra - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Erroll Garner - Live in Singer Concertzaal, Laren
programme.desc: On June 18, 1962, American pianist and composer Erroll Garner performed at the Singer Concertzaal in Laren. The vibrant and joyous concert was played with drummer Kelly Martin and bassist Eddie Calhoun, each long-standing collaborators from Garner's trio. The Singer Concertzaal in Laren, the Netherlands is a concert hall and museum dedicated to the preservation of the art collection of American William Henry Singer.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Oslo
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Skylark
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Moondog And The London Saxophonique
programme.desc: Moondog, a gaunt, mysterious and extravagantly-garbed blind street musician was celebrated among New Yorkers for two decades before gaining acclaim in Europe as an avant-garde composer conducting orchestras before royalty. Artists such as Charlie Parker, Leonard Bernstein, Steve Reich and Philip Glass have called him one of the great musical visionaries of our century.?Day in and day out, the man whose real name is Louis T.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: Weather Update - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1986, jazz-fusion band “Weather Update” was one of the bands appearing here.

programme.title: Omar Sosa - Quarteto Afrocubano
programme.desc: While always keeping one foot firmly anchored in the traditions of his home country, Cuba, Omar Sosa tirelessly explores music from the Caribbean to India, and West Africa to the Arab world. Since he left Cuba in 1993, the pianist has been blending his Afro-Cuban roots with jazz, hip hop, electro and world music.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: On The Road With Duke Ellington: II
programme.desc: In May 2014, the Conservatory of Amsterdam hosted a unique conference about one of the greatest jazz composers of the 20th century: Duke Ellington. Musicologists and musicians with a special bond with Ellington and his music spoke about his life and music. Among them were David Schiff, author of ‘The Ellington Century’, and Harvey Cohen, author of ‘Duke Ellington’s America’.

programme.title: Troy 'Trombone Shorty' Andrews: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz phenomenon Trombone Shorty dishes out a mix of funk, jazz, hip-hop and soul at this concert at the French festival Jazz à Vienne. Playing with the energy of a rock star, Troy Andrews, a.k.a. ‘Trombone Shorty’, pays homage to jazz legends. With his hypnotic performance and boundless energy, Trombone Shorty puts up an unparalleled performance.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 1 of 4.

programme.title: Le Comte de Monte Cristo
programme.desc: Villefort apprend que Sabrine, la sage-femme qu’il avait fait interner après qu’elle avait aidé sa maîtresse à accoucher en secret, s’est échappée de l’asile. Il commence à se méfier de Monte-Cristo et de sa fortune. Pendant ce temps, Edmond fait venir à Paris une jeune femme : Haydée, ancienne esclave qu’il a affranchie. Elle est la fille du défunt Ali Pacha, trahi par Fernand lorsqu’il servait en Algérie. Par ailleurs, Edmond...

programme.title: Le Comte de Monte Cristo
programme.desc: À la suite de l’arrestation de Valentine pour le meurtre de sa grand-mère, Edmond révèle à Villefort qu'Héloïse lui a volé une fiole de poison lors d’un dîner. Tandis que Danglars finalise les préparatifs du mariage entre Spada et Eugénie, Edmond et Spada organisent la fuite d’Eugénie avec sa professeure de chant. En même temps, Edmond transmet à la presse et à la police des preuves du délit d'initié de Danglars et Hermine. Enfin,...

programme.title: Le Pitch Cinéma
programme.desc: Chaque semaine Le Pitch Cinéma vous présente 5 sorties de la semaine. Rythmé et graphique, une mystérieuse silhouette en contre jour devant un grand écran « donne les clefs aux téléspectateurs pour se forger leur opinion » et décider ensuite d'aller voir les films… ou pas ! Le Pitch Cinéma fait appel à la culture cinématographique des téléspectateurs et propose pour chaque sortie de film un véritable jeu d’association : si vous avez...

programme.title: Volontaire
programme.desc: Histoires courtes - 'Festival off-Courts : la rentrée des courts à Trouville !' Circé (27) aime Abel et vit avec Vincent. Mais quand elle découvre sa grossesse, les illusions tombent : Abel n'est pas à la hauteur et elle n’aime plus Vincent. Il faut pourtant faire un choix : garder l'enfant ou avorter ?

programme.title: La Ligne de Vie
programme.desc: Histoires courtes - 'Festival off-Courts : la rentrée des courts à Trouville !' 24 décembre 1916. De l’autre côté d’un check-point allemand, un camion acheminant du courrier est arrêté, criblé de balles. A l’intérieur, un homme tué. Un autre homme et une femme, qui étaient en mission postale, clament leur innocence dans la mort de leur compagnon de voyage, et de leur présence en zone ennemie. La radio qui les guidait se serait...

programme.title: Ne Crains pas le Bruit de mes Ailes
programme.desc: Histoires courtes - 'Festival off-Courts : la rentrée des courts à Trouville !' Le jardin des plantes… comme une métaphore du voyage et de la découverte, un monde miniature qui ferait appel aux émotions, aux évocations, aux souvenirs de la voix qui nous guide tout au long du récit pour au final nous permettre de mieux comprendre le monde, notre interdépendance avec celui-ci et nous interroger sur notre place au sein du règne...

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 25
programme.desc: O Velho do Rio deixa Jove aos cuidados de Juma. José Leôncio vai ao Rio de Janeiro falar com Madeleine. Guta chega à tapera de Juma e pergunta por Jove. Tibério encontra Jove na tapera de Juma. Juma aponta a arma para Tibério e afirma que ninguém pode saber sobre Jove. Madeleine se descontrola ao saber do sumiço de Jove. Tibério volta para a fazenda, mas não conta sobre Jove.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 26
programme.desc: Guta desmoraliza Tenório na frente da mãe. José Leôncio decide se divorciar de Madeleine. Jove recobra a consciência e Juma fica feliz. José Leôncio vai embora da mansão dos Novaes. O Velho do Rio diz a Juma que Jove não vai mais sair do Pantanal. Tibério se surpreende quando Jove afirma que não deixará a tapera. Tadeu avisa que Jove está vivo e Zé Leôncio dá a notícia para a família de Madeleine.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 27
programme.desc: Juma fica nervosa com a proximidade de Jove e exige que ele vá embora de sua casa. Mariana e Irma se irritam com Nayara. José Leôncio decide procurar Jove e o Velho do Rio. Jove tenta fotografar Juma. Guta sofre com a ausência do filho de Madeleine. Tibério repreende Jove por não tentar se entender com o pai. Alcides não gosta quando Guta afirma que gosta de Jove.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 28
programme.desc: José Leôncio quer conversar com Tibério. Guta se abre com Jove. Tibério vai embora com José Leôncio, e Muda reage contrariada. José Leôncio questiona Jove sobre o Velho do Rio. Maria Bruaca reclama da viagem de Tenório. Jove provoca José Leôncio. Mariana se preocupa com as finanças da família.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 29
programme.desc: Jove provoca José Leôncio. Mariana se preocupa com as finanças da família. O Velho do Rio repreende Juma por ter mandado Jove embora. Tibério questiona Muda sobre sua presença na tapera de Juma. Juma não deixa Jove tirar uma foto sua. Guta decide ir embora com Jove e pede carona para Tadeu. Muda pensa em cumprir sua vingança contra Juma. Jove recrimina Tenório quando ele critica Guta.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 30
programme.desc: Juma e Muda são ameaçadas por um caçador. Juma ataca o caçador, que foge desesperado. Jove e Tadeu veem um homem ser atacado por piranhas. Gustavo cozinha para Madeleine e Nayara. Jove defende Juma dos comentários dos peões. Muda tenta matar Juma. O Velho do Rio ajuda Jove a encontrar o caminho para a tapera de Juma. Zaquieu atrapalha uma live de Madeleine. Jove procura Juma.

programme.title: Tô Ryca!
programme.desc: A frentista Selminha descobre que tem uma herança. Para botar a mão na bolada, ela precisa gastar 30 milhões de reais em 30 dias sem contar a ninguém.

programme.title: Globo Repórter - Ep. 1929
programme.desc: Com apresentação de William Bonner e Sandra Annenberg, o ‘Globo Repórter’ é um programa de reportagens com foco em comportamento, aventura, ciência e natureza. Apresenta destinos do mundo, além de novas pesquisas nas áreas de saúde e tecnologia.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 75
programme.desc: Juca pede desculpas a Helena, mas ela não aceita. Zé Bolacha fala do pai de Irene, e ela estranha. Filomena conversa com Adalberto sobre Isabela. Juca volta à praça e encontra Ana.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 108
programme.desc: Nos anos 1920, Rafael e Luna se apaixonam. Assassinada a mando da invejosa Cristina, Luna reencarna como Serena e novamente se apaixona por Rafael, confirmando o amor eterno.

programme.title: Passione - Ep. 144
programme.desc: Bete exige que Agnello e Stela se expliquem. Valentina é hostilizada pela vizinhança e ameaça se vingar de todos. Talarico sugere que Diogo entre na pensão e procure o que quer. Clara fica desolada ao saber que Kelly foi levada para o abrigo. Totó se surpreende ao encontrar Agnello e Stela falando com Bete. Brígida fica intrigada com o nervosismo de Stela. Totó afirma a Bete que, se Agnello estiver envolvido no assassinato de Saulo,...

programme.title: A Nobreza do Amor - Ep. 88
programme.desc: Jendal recebe de Chinua uma lista de pretendentes, enquanto Kênia critica a decisão do rei. Em Biri-Biri, Tonho delira chamando por Alika, deixando Caetana confusa e levando Onildo a perceber a verdade sobre Vera e Lúcia. Onildo informa a Caetana que Tonho contraiu uma infecção grave. Viriato acusa Sebastião de envolvimento com o ataque ao ateliê e ameaça usar Carrapato como testemunha.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 76
programme.desc: Ana e Juca conversam amigavelmente. Adalberto visita Isabela e duvida da gravidez. Nina descobre sobre Zé Bolacha e Irene. Solange e Alfredo tramam um golpe em Eliseo.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 109
programme.desc: Felipe visita Mirella. O delegado faz perguntas a Roberval. Crispim supervisiona o namoro de Mirna. Guto ameaça Xavier. Cristina aconselha Felipe. Hélio ajuda Serena.

programme.title: Orgulho e Paixão - Ep. 98
programme.desc: Amélia cobra a Ema a promessa que ela lhe fez. O Barão decide se mudar para São Paulo. Lady Margareth fala mal de Darcy para Julieta. Elisabeta ouve o depoimento de Ernesto contra a fábrica de tecidos. Uirapuru encontra Josephine. Julieta tira satisfações com Darcy sobre o andamento da construção da ferrovia. Lady Margareth manipula Olegário. Uirapuru vê Brandão e Josephine se beijando.

programme.title: Por Você - Ep. 7

programme.title: Still A Mystery T5 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: Uma dançarina é baleada em casa e os detetives tentam descobrir quem teria motivos para a matar. Um cigarro encontrado no local do crime pode dar respostas.

programme.title: Still A Mystery T5 - Ep. 28
programme.desc: Uma mãe desaparece de casa e a suspeita recai nos seus admiradores. Será que uma confissão-surpresa resolve o mistério?.

programme.title: Disappeared T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Após o desaparecimento de Amy, a Polícia tem um suspeito, mas não tem uma cena de crime, um corpo, ou pistas. Mas, graças a um inesperado informante, o caso é resolvido.

programme.title: Disappeared T1 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Um astro do basquetebol e a sua namorada desaparecem quando velejavam. A Polícia tem de localizar o irmão do jogador, que é a única pessoa que pode saber o que se passou.

programme.title: Signs Of A Psychopath T5 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Na cidade de Ocala, na Florida, um adolescente é vítima de um jovem psicopata, de uma ex-namorada vingativa e de alguns dos seus amigos delinquentes.

programme.title: Chris Brown: A History Of Violence T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Chris Brown tem sido elogiado pela sua inovação e talento. Porém, aconteceu algo que mostrou ao mundo um lado muito mais negro do músico.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Em 2015, Tiffany Boyer envolveu-se numa situação tensa numa festa, em Albuquerque. É dada como desaparecida e ninguém fala, mas um detetive descobre uma conspiração de vingança.

programme.title: Mean Girl Murders T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Depois que a doce e insegura Kelly Bullwinkle é encontrada morta num local remoto, os investigadores descobrem uma trama de ciúmes e mentiras entre as amizades.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Investigação criminal vista pelas câmaras dos agentes dos departamentos de polícia dos EUA. Siga as reviravoltas dramáticas que levam à captura de um assassino.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Tiffany cresceu sabendo que o seu pai era uma pessoa má, mas sempre se manteve calada. Quando consegue fugir dele, vê finalmente a real extensão da maldade do pai.

programme.title: Game Day Murders T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Patrick Dennehy, jogador de basquetebol da Universidade de Baylor, desaparece. A verdade é mais chocante do que se poderia imaginar.

programme.title: A Killer Among Friends T2 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Uma licenciada da Universidade de Auburn desaparece no Alabama. Os amigos suspeitam uns dos outros e a procura de respostas recai nos mais próximos.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Quando Susan Hamlin entra numa esquadra para confessar a sua participação num culto satânico e planeia matar o marido, ninguém poderia adivinhar que a verdade é ainda mais bizarra.

programme.title: Evil Lives Here T2 - Ep. 5

programme.title: Enquête Exclusive
programme.desc: Selon un rapport du Conseil de l’Europe, relayé par l’ensemble des fédérations sportives, un enfant sur sept serait victime d’agressions sexuelles dans le monde du sport. Un chiffre particulièrement inquiétant. Partout où il y a des mineurs, il y a des prédateurs et le football, avec deux millions deux cent-mille licenciés, est l’un des milieux les plus exposés.

programme.title: Enquête Exclusive
programme.desc: Serveurs, voituriers, plagistes ou femmes de chambre… ils sont les petites mains de nos vacances. Chaque été, plus d’un million de saisonniers font tourner la grande machine touristique française. Pour certains, c’est le bon plan rêvé : soleil, pourboires et gros salaires. Pour d’autres, c’est un calvaire : pénurie de main-d’œuvre, horaires à rallonge, travail non déclaré et logements indignes.

programme.title: L'amour Vu Du Pré
programme.desc: « L'amour vu du pré » accueille des invités de marque sur son canapé. À plusieurs reprises cette saison, Arthur et Studio Danielle rejoindront les anciens agriculteurs et prétendant(e)s pour commenter « L'amour est dans le pré ». Avec leurs personnalités bien affirmées, leur humour, leur spontanéité et leur regard sans filtre, ils se prendront rapidement au jeu des confidences, des commentaires et des réactions à chaud.

programme.title: Scènes De Ménages
programme.desc: Votre couple vous désole ? Vous vous lamentez de vivre seul ? Scènes de Ménages va vous aider à relativiser !

La 118 intervient lorsqu’une demande en mariage de haut vol est contrariée par le braquage d’une banque. L’équipe porte également secours à une future mariée coincée dans son carrosse juste avant la noce. Athena offre son soutien à une femme dont le mari vient de s’éteindre à leur domicile…

Alors que la station spatiale internationale est gravement endommagée par des débris, Athena et Hen doivent risquer leur vie pour réparer un bras robotique et permettre le retour de l'équipage sur Terre. En parallèle, des flashbacks révèlent un ancien drame qui a marqué Athena et façonné son sens du devoir et du sacrifice.
